nom: Philosophy Microdelivery Resurfacing Solution with 4% AHA's, Cica and Vitamin C

segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin is the most frequently named skin type; most reviewers report it is gentle enough for reactive skin including rosacea, though a few describe stinging, small blisters, or bumps that led them to stop using it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe mixed results: one had her already-dry summer skin worsen within two days, while another with chronically dry, flaky skin found it removed the flaking and let other products absorb better.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin and large T-zone pores, already tolerant of AHAs and BHAs, found this product did nothing noticeable for her skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it helped balance oily and dry areas at once.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her normal skin as tolerating it well with no irritation.

concerns.spots: Improvement in dark spots, sun spots, and uneven tone is one of the most consistently reported benefits, with several reviewers calling it the first product that visibly faded their discoloration; results are described as gradual over weeks, not immediate.
concerns.redness: Reports on redness are mixed: some reviewers, including one with mask-related rosacea flare-ups, see their redness improve with continued use, while another says it has not helped the redness left by acne scarring.
concerns.blemishes: Reactions on acne are mixed: some reviewers report their breakouts got worse, including one who saw the pattern repeat on a second try, while others report their acne and acne scars gradually improved.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers report dryness or visible dry patches after early use, especially in a dry climate, while others specifically credit the product with clearing away dry, flaky texture over time.

aspects.libelle: Messy pump that squirts product past the cotton pad
Also used successfully on hands and chest
Some initial stinging or purging when starting out

extraits.titre: Little bumps all on forehead and cheeks
extraits.texte: I love this product at first, but after the 3rd use I noticed my skin felt rough, dry, and is covered in tiny bumps on my forehead and cheeks. I'm in my late 30s so I don't have an issue with acne, but it almost feels like tiny pimples or hives. I will be returning this product as this reaction is worrisome. I love philosophy and have used their products for years. I'm really disappointed that this didn't work out and an hoping this skin irritation clears up quickly.

I'm typically a huge fan of Philosophy products as they are usually are kind to my sometimes sensitive skin. First off, I like this bottle. It's unique in that it's curve to keep the product from spilling out and you have to push it in yo get product out which helps control you from getting too much in your cotton pad. You use this like a toner. The package recommends 5 times a week. Unfortunately, my already summer dry skin freaked after 2 days and my face became much dryer with visibly dry patches and tightness. I had to call in some serious moisturizer and take a few days off from this product. It doesn't have an overwhelming scent and I'm betting if my skin wasn't already dry this would be far more effective. I'll give it another go once my skin is more hydrated.

As someone with rosacea that has been exacerbated by masks, I was a little hesitant to dive in full force with this product. However, used in conjunction with my Rx rosacea products it's been a good combo. I avoid the sensitive areas on my nose and chin and stick to cheeks and forehead. It's not an overnight change, but you can notice a difference.

extraits.titre: Clears up dark spots and brightens complexion!
extraits.texte: I've been using the resurfacing toner for almost a month now, and the areas on my face where I had discoloration and dark spots is super clear and even now! My mom complimented my makeup the other day thinking I already had foundation on, but I was bare faced! My skin feels smoother, and looks brighter. I love this toner! Please never discontinue this product, Philosophy!

I've been using this for about 9 months and it's made a tremendous difference in my skin texture. I have very dry skin that seemed to always be flaky no matter what moisturizer I used. This product removes the dry skin allowing my serums and moisturizers to be better absorbed. I no longer have dry, flaky skin and the overall texture and appearance has improved. I could see a difference after only a few days of use.

I was absolutely thrilled to try this because, I have extremely sensitive skin that breaks out or reacts easily. It has centella asiatica which is my all time favorite skincare ingredient. It also had 4% ahas, vitamin c, and niacinamide which are all great. This is a very gentle exfoliator that also replenishes. My skin hasn't broken out or been irritated by it but I also don't use it more than a couple times a week. I'm very happy with how soft, smooth, and hydrated it makes my skin. My acne scars are fading and I can see my skin tone starting to even out. The only bad thing I can really say is that I'm not a fan of the pump to get the product out. Other than that it works well with all my other products and I can't wait to see how my skin looks when I'm done with it. Overall, it's a great product.

This has definitely helped with uneven skin tone like sunspots but hasnt helped with redness from acne scarring which is what i was hoping. It has helped with breakouts. Been using it about a month now. I think it's a good product and does serve a purpose. I'm not sure it is does what i needed it for. I will continue to use it and see if it gets better
